Base Design refreshes global visual identity for Visa - Design Week
Visa updates its visual identity
stories.summary: Design agency Base Design has created a more compact logo and a new typeface for Visa. The refresh includes a blocky hero graphic intended to market to a younger generation. Executive creative director Min Lew says the challenge is relevance, not recognition. The 2021 wordmark remains unchanged.

stories.title: Turner’s House rebrand captures the many sides of the artist - Creative Review
BCL updates brand identity
stories.summary: Law firm BCL has unveiled a new brand identity and website. The firm, which has operated for over 35 years, adopted the positioning statement At home in difficult places to reflect its expertise in high-stakes legal matters. The firm says it has evolved significantly since opening.

stories.title: SAHI launches Stride identity
stories.summary: Trading platform SAHI has introduced a new brand identity called SAHI Stride. The system features a monochrome palette with a single accent color and two new typefaces. The company says every move begins with intent. Account features and trading processes remain unchanged for all users.

stories.title: SKAVA refreshes brand identity
stories.summary: Electrical controls brand SKAVA has unveiled a new identity centered on a philosophy of Simple Luxury. The company says the change reflects its vision of combining engineering excellence with refined aesthetics. The brand, formerly known as Skin Electric, has been in operation since 2005.

stories.title: Denver Design District rebrands
stories.summary: The Denver Design District has unveiled a new brand identity designed to transform the commerce hub into a cultural destination. The rebrand aims to make the space more accessible to the public while honoring its architectural heritage. The district now features a mix of retail and food.

stories.title: Sonny's Corner branding
stories.summary: Design studio Order has created a brand identity for the Brooklyn bar Sonny's Corner. The design utilizes a hand-lettered alphabet inspired by subway posters and a diamond motif. The bar occupies a location that has served the neighborhood for nearly a century.

stories.title: NeueHaus branding uses keyboard characters
stories.summary: Design studio Buro has relaunched the branding for NeueHaus using five keyboard characters as the primary mark. The identity is built around a platform for independent specialists the network calls The Externals. The studio says the branding is designed to be a flexible, member-first platform.

stories.title: Wolff Olins reimagines Decathlon
stories.summary: Wolff Olins has rebuilt the Decathlon brand identity around the concept of wonder, replacing a focus on podiums and perfection. The global sports retailer, which operates over 2,000 stores, says the new system is designed to unite 85 brands into one. The blue color remains.

stories.title: The Other Almanac redesign
stories.summary: Designer Callum Abbott and editor Ana Ratner have redesigned The Other Almanac using 40 free fonts and archival cuts. The project was completed with a zero-dollar budget for new photography or illustration. The design draws inspiration from 1970s calendars and open-source engravings.

stories.title: Mucho creates Biotic identity
stories.summary: Design studio Mucho has created a brand identity for the nonprofit Biotic using a single black dot that multiplies via reaction-diffusion software. The system allows the pattern to branch across various surfaces. The studio says the mark is as plain as the science behind the synthetic cell.

stories.title: Graphasel designs vermouth packaging
stories.summary: Hungarian studio Graphasel has designed packaging for Kontyos Don Cherry Vermut featuring vertical fluting and striped labels. The studio says the goal was a youthful identity that breaks away from traditional aperitif clichés. The design rhythm is repeated across the bottle, cap, and label.

stories.title: Roboto Studio updates Flowhub
stories.summary: Roboto Studio has rebuilt the Flowhub brand identity using a single mark, one typeface, and a bright green color. The system covers the company's point of sale and payment interface. Flowhub processes more than $4 billion in annual sales for specialty retailers across the United States.

stories.title: Pentagram rebrands Parker Institute
stories.summary: Pentagram has rebranded the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy, shortening the name to two words. The new identity features condensed type and a modular system designed to connect academic labs and biopharma startups. The group uses the tagline Cancer Ends Here.

stories.title: Koto designs De-extinction packaging
stories.summary: Design studio Koto has created a brand identity for De-extinction using acid green and hot pink graphics on compostable packaging. The design features thick outlines of dinosaurs as warnings. The studio says the posters are intended to encourage consumers to re-package their future.

Canva opens its design platform to AI agents
stories.summary: Canva has opened its Model Context Protocol to all developers and AI agents, aiming to become the design infrastructure for the internet. The company says it wants to be the one-stop platform for creative workflows. It is currently betting that design taste beats general AI.

stories.title: Building the design layer of the internet: opening Canva to every agent and developer
stories.summary: An idea might start in a conversation with an AI assistant or a task handed to an agent, but bringing it to life for other people usually means creating something visual, like a presentation or a social campaign. With today’s updates, our design tools are there wherever this work happens.

stories.title: Adobe, Figma and Canva target enterprise market
stories.summary: Adobe, Figma and Canva are strengthening their enterprise product lines as generative AI shifts individual users toward simpler tools. The companies are touting precision that AI cannot replicate, betting that business customers require more sophisticated results. The industry is currently redefining what counts as a professional task.

stories.title: NID Ahmedabad designs India’s cultural pavilion for Namaste Canton 2026
stories.summary: The National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad, served as the design partner for the Namaste Canton 2026 event in Guangzhou, China. The pavilion featured an immersive experience inspired by the streets and bazaars of Rajasthan. The project showcased India’s cultural heritage, contemporary creativity, and cuisine to international visitors.

stories.title: NID Ahmedabad designs India’s cultural pavilion for Namaste Canton 2026
stories.summary: The National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad, designed the Indian pavilion for the Namaste Canton 2026 event in Guangzhou, China. The space drew inspiration from traditional Indian streets and Rajasthan’s architecture. The project was led by Professor Pravinsinh Solanki, with branding and graphic design handled by Professor Jagadish Kumar.

stories.title: NID designs India’s cultural pavilion in China
stories.summary: Faculty and students from the National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad, designed the Indian cultural pavilion for the Namaste Canton 2026 event in Guangzhou. The exhibit was conceptualised around the atmosphere of traditional Indian streets and the architectural character of Rajasthan to provide an immersive experience for visitors.

stories.title: Neoteque Design and Trade outlines diversified business goals
stories.summary: Bhavnagar-based Neoteque Design and Trade Private Limited is expanding its operations across real estate, architecture, interior design, and industrial trading. The company is led by four directors, including Managing Director Arifbhai Gagnani, and operates under the stated philosophy that quality is a commitment rather than an option.

stories.title: Dori’s thematic collection strengthens Bandhani craft’s place in its brand identity - The Retail Jeweller India
Harisadan by Uncut Design Lab: Reworking a rest house in Tirumala - Hotelier India
Arpita Sheth designs two distinct Mumbai restaurants
stories.summary: Transform Design Studio founder Arpita Sheth has designed two Mumbai restaurants, Munchbox and Munchbox Thali, under a single brand. Sheth gave the sister locations contrasting personalities, with one space rooted in Rajasthani heritage and the other focused on contemporary art to influence the dining experience.

stories.title: JSW Motors unveils new brand identity
stories.summary: JSW Motors has introduced a new logo and brand identity ahead of its December 3 vehicle launch. The company, which is the JSW Group’s passenger vehicle arm, intends the new visual signature to represent its future mobility ambitions across dealerships and digital platforms.

stories.title: Gujarat knitting unit produces textured cotton polos
stories.summary: WildAss, a knitting unit near the Little Rann of Kutch, is manufacturing textured cotton polo shirts by knitting patterns directly into the fabric. The company uses pre-dyed yarn and knitted collars to maintain shape and colour, selling the garments directly to consumers across India.

stories.title: DLI-backed C2i Semiconductors raises $15 million from Peak XV, marking largest funding round for Indian chip startup - D
Asia startup funding reaches $122.3 million
stories.summary: Asian startups secured $122.3 million in funding this week, with India leading the regional activity. Fintech lender Finnable raised $43.8 million, while wealthtech startup Ionic Wealth secured $19.5 million. Singapore-based MetaOptics also raised $25 million to support its semiconductor fabrication plans in the United States.

stories.title: Munich startup Starforge raises €6.6 million for fusion reactors
stories.summary: Starforge has raised €6.6 million to mass-produce fusion reactors in factories. While fusion power plants have historically been treated as one-off projects, the Munich-based startup aims to design its reactors as products to be stamped out in batches of dozens or hundreds.

stories.title: Rendezvous Robotics raises $20 million for modular spacecraft
stories.summary: Colorado-based Rendezvous Robotics has raised $20 million to build spacecraft that assemble themselves in orbit. The company’s design uses independent modular tiles that maneuver and connect autonomously. It plans to test the technology next year by joining seven spacecraft tiles in space.

stories.title: USPF supports startups tackling healthcare and agriculture
stories.summary: The Universal Service Provision Fund is supporting 11 Nigerian startups competing for a N10 million prize pool. The participants are developing digital solutions to improve healthcare access and assist livestock farmers with animal disease management in areas with limited infrastructure and connectivity.

stories.title: GEF Capital Partners closes India Climate Fund IV at $615 million
stories.summary: GEF Capital Partners has raised $615 million for its fourth India-focused climate fund, exceeding its initial target. The fund is 40% larger than the firm’s previous iteration and will target growth-stage cleantech businesses across India and South Asia with backing from global institutional investors.

stories.title: Indē wild reports loss despite revenue growth
stories.summary: Beauty startup indē wild posted a net loss of ₹95 Lakh for FY26, despite a 139% increase in operating revenue to ₹59.8 Cr. The company’s expenses rose over 2.5 times during the fiscal year as it expanded operations under founders Diipa and Oleg Büller-Khosla.

stories.title: Kabeer Biswas’ AI startup M raises $9 million
stories.summary: AI startup M, founded by Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas, has raised $9 million in a round led by RTP Global. Existing investors Peak XV Partners and Blume Ventures also participated. The company has now raised approximately $20 million in total capital to date.

stories.title: Product design and the limits of AI
stories.summary: Designers are increasingly delegating core tasks like concept development and interface creation to AI tools. While this approach is popular among newer specialists, the lack of extensive experience can make it difficult to assess the quality of the output. Mockups may look fine until they are used.

stories.title: Usability testing as a research method
stories.summary: Usability testing involves observing people as they attempt realistic tasks with user interfaces to identify design problems and opportunities. The process aims to uncover user behavior and preferences. Even experienced designers use the method to validate their work, as intuition does not always guarantee a great interface.

stories.title: Solo design work in the age of AI
stories.summary: A designer with six years of experience on a large team has shifted their workflow since January. Previous experiments with tools like Figma Make and Gemini provided only tiny glimpses of impact. The transition to solo work has prompted a reevaluation of how AI fits into the process.

stories.title: Study tracks AI use in Australian classrooms
stories.summary: The University of Melbourne is conducting a five-year study on the influence of AI in teaching, learning, and assessment. The research focuses on secondary school teachers in Australia. Data from 2025 is currently being analyzed to determine how often and for what specific tasks educators use AI tools.

stories.title: Anoop Chand joins Kotak Mahindra Bank
stories.summary: Anoop Chand has been appointed as deputy vice president at Kotak Mahindra Bank, effective October 2026. Chand previously served as associate director at Razorpay, where he worked on strategic products including WhatsApp Payments. He has also held roles at HDFC Bank, SBI Card, and ICICI Bank.

stories.title: Dolly Tayal leaves Burson Genesis India
stories.summary: Dolly Tayal has stepped down as managing director of Burson Genesis India after two years. Tayal, who was the youngest person to hold the role, cited no specific reason for her departure. She has over two decades of experience in the communication industry and has no immediate plans.

stories.title: Puneet Das resigns from Britannia Industries
stories.summary: Puneet Das has resigned as chief marketing officer of Britannia Industries after ten months to pursue an external opportunity. Das joined the company in February 2026. He previously spent six years at Tata Consumer Products, where he managed marketing and growth strategy for the beverages portfolio.

stories.title: Paddington bear designer receives RSA honour
stories.summary: Tahra Zafar, the designer responsible for the Paddington Bear onstage suit, has been named a Royal Designer for Industry by the Royal Society of Arts. The honour is awarded to designers who demonstrate outstanding talent. Zafar is one of five new recipients of the title this year.

stories.title: Royal Society for Arts names new designers
stories.summary: The Royal Society for Arts has appointed five new Royal Designers for Industry to mark its 90th anniversary. The awards recognize talent in fields including landscape architecture, technology, and fashion. The title is limited to 200 designers at any one time, ensuring the roster remains exclusive.

research.title: Harvard’s tiny UV light chip could help shrink quantum computers
research.summary: Harvard-led researchers have developed a microscopic device that generates 120 times more ultraviolet light than previous comparable approaches by efficiently converting red light into UV. The breakthrough could unlock smaller quantum computers, ultra-precise atomic clocks, and compact environmental sensors.

research.title: Scientists identify two ages when children may be most vulnerable to screen time
research.summary: Scientists have identified two potentially critical periods when screen time may be especially detrimental to children's learning and memory: infancy and the start of formal schooling. Greater screen exposure during these developmental windows was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later.

research.title: What is a thought made of? Why human consciousness may be beyond AI’s reach
research.summary: A new theory suggests that the brain may chemically encode and retrieve memories rather than relying solely on electrical signals. Researchers propose that interactions between brain cells and their molecular surroundings could help explain the intimate connection between memory, emotion, and thought. research.title: IBM quantum computer solves problem classical computers can’t in just 15 minutes
research.summary: IBM and University of Chicago researchers have demonstrated that a quantum computer can complete an extraordinarily complex calculation in just 15 minutes, beyond the practical reach of leading classical computing methods. A novel error-detection technique also allows scientists to establish confidence in the accuracy of the results, overcoming.
